description: The Safe Water Project is an open-source software tool listed in Awesome Sustainable Technology, a curated list of open-source sustainability projects under the section "Water", published or maintained by codeforboston (repository owner; maintainers as on the project page). is a team of volunteers at Code for Boston who are using data modeling, data visualization and machine learning to predict, visualize, and share data about the presence of hazardous drinking and surface water contaminants in the United States. Coverage: not geographically bound. The list files it under "Water" (water resources). The listed link gives the project or repository page; nothing was installed or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the list entry (repository not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water resources studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-awesome-sustainable-technology.
